latest_release.name: antdv-next@1.8.3
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs(blog): introduce antdv next mobile by @aibayanyu20 in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1104
* fix(Select): render Option children and AutoComplete dataSource options by @dogledogle in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1105
* docs(avatar): align slots table and AvatarGroup API table with antd upstream by @dogledogle in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1108
* fix: prevent Modal and Drawer render errors with null close icons by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1107
* docs(table): add row click selection demo by @dogledogle in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1109
* fix(button): [sync] prevent unintended transitions on layout changes by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1113
* fix(config-provider): honor holderRender provider priority by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1111
* fix(menu): execute function expandIcon renderers by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1110
* fix(segmented): keep item icons centred on the label at any icon size by @Mittalnew in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1115
* fix(border-beam): export BorderBeamItem type from root entry by @dogledogle in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1117
* fix(form): preserve nested sibling fields in setFieldsValue by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1106
* fix(badge): expose nativeElement via ref and export BadgeRef type by @dogledogle in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1116
* refactor(skeleton): [sync] remove unused image circle styles by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1121
* refactor(table): [sync] remove unused pagination callback info by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1118
* fix(slider): [sync] add the missing startPoint prop for single sliders by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1119
* refactor(menu): [sync] remove redundant span check in MenuItem by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1120
* chore(sync): advance ant-design cursor to 3bf122d3e by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1122
* fix(config-provider): honor replaced popup and target container callbacks by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1123
* fix(modal): apply hook modal update and destroy queued before mount by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1124
* docs: normalize locale-aware links in docs by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1125
* fix(form): restore generic typing across Form APIs by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1126
* ci: run vue-tsc typecheck for antdv-next by @aibayanyu20 in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1127
* feat(form): support field-meta filtering in getFieldsValue by @jiangrong-devops in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1128
* docs(button): document icon prop and color solid default by @dogledogle in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1129
* fix(tabs): [sync] prevent drag lag on card tabs by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1134
* fix(upload): [sync] warn when linkProps is an invalid JSON string by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1132
* fix(input-number): [sync] correct affix spacing around spinner step actions by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1130
* perf(descriptions): [sync] skip redundant filtering before row calculation by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1133
* refactor(affix): [sync] remove redundant measurement status by @yanyubot in https://github.com/antdv-next/antdv-next/pull/1135
* refactor(slider): [sync] remove redundant tooltip raf cancellation by @yanyubot in https://github.c

discussions.title: 想确认一下，对form组件绑定的model对应的响应式ref内容进行修改会触发form-item的rules校验是符合预期的吗
Table 的行选择文档示例可以优化
输入框清除按钮能否加一个tabindex的配置
Antdv Next 是否计划支持全局自定义时区？
antdv-next 的公共导出里没有 MenuInfo / SelectInfo，它们被关在内部包里
form表单校验 搭配 i18n 一起使用，切换国际化表单校验规则不会切换
树形表格的children为空数组时应该不显示展开按钮
有计划开发 admin 平台么？

detail.readme:
Antdv Next

Antdv Next is a Vue 3 enterprise component library built on the Ant Design design system. [![CI status][github-action-image]][github-action-url] [![codecov][codecov-image]][codecov-url] [![NPM version][npm-image]][npm-url] [![NPM downloads][download-image]][download-url] [![][jsdelivr-image]][jsdelivr-url] [![][nuxt-image]][nuxt-url] English · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md) ## ❤️ Sponsors | | | | | | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
## ✨ Features - 🌈 Enterprise-class UI designed for web applications. - 📦 A set of high-quality Vue3 components out of the box. - 🛡 Written in TypeScript with predictable static types. - ⚙️ Whole package of design resources and development tools. - 🌍 Internationalization support for dozens of languages. - 🎨 Powerful theme customization based on CSS-in-JS. ## 🖥 Environment Support - Modern browsers - Server-side Rendering - [Electron](https://www.electronjs.org/) | [
Edge](https://godban.github.io/browsers-support-badges/) | [
Firefox](https://godban.github.io/browsers-support-badges/) | [
Chrome](https://godban.github.io/browsers-support-badges/) | [
Safari](https://godban.github.io/browsers-support-badges/) | [
Electron](https://godban.github.io/browsers-support-badges/) | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | last 2 versions | last 2 versions | last 2 versions | last 2 versions | last 2 versions | ## 📦 Install ```bash npm install antdv-next ``` ```bash yarn add antdv-next ``` ```bash pnpm add antdv-next ``` ```bash bun add antdv-next ``` ## ✅ Unit Test Coverage - Run coverage locally: `pnpm test:coverage` - Coverage output directory: `coverage/` - On GitHub Release publish (`release.published`), CI runs unit tests with coverage and uploads the `coverage/` artifact via the `Unit Test Upload` workflow. ## Acknowledgements Antdv Next is inspired by and built upon the following open-source projects. - [Ant Design](https://ant.design/) - [Vue.js](https://vuejs.org/) - [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/) ## Contribute We warmly welcome you to participate in our open source project. **Pull Request:** 1. Fork the repository. 2. Create your own branch: `git checkout -b feat-xxxx`. 3. Commit your changes: `git commit -am 'feat(function): add xxxxx'`. 4. Push your branch: `git push origin feat-xxxx`. 5. Submit a pull request. Thank you to all the people who already contributed to Antdv Next!
